narrative.intro: Southwest Valley Constructors has federal contract obligations totaling $2.3B in FY2026 to date. Southwest Valley Constructors received 5 awards so far in the current fiscal year, with an average award size of $451M. Southwest Valley Constructors saw most of its FY2026 obligations come from the Department of Homeland Security, which obligated $2.2B. Southwest Valley Constructors also has obligations from the Department of Defense totaling $10.6M. Southwest Valley Constructors works primarily in Commercial and Institutional Building Construction, with $2.2B in obligations, and in Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction, with $10.6M in obligations. Southwest Valley Constructors has a multi-year history of federal obligations that ranges from $78.4M in FY21 to negative entries in several later years and then the large FY26 total. Southwest Valley Constructors figures for the current fiscal year are partial and reflect fiscal year to date obligations, not full-year totals.

sections.heading: Who are Southwest Valley Constructors' top federal buyers?
sections.body: Department of Homeland Security is the top buyer, obligating $2.2B. Department of Defense is a secondary buyer, obligating $10.6M. These two agencies account for the majority of the listed buying agencies for FY2026 to date.

sections.heading: What markets and award sizes characterize Southwest Valley Constructors?
sections.body: Commercial and Institutional Building Construction is the largest market, with $2.2B in obligations. Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction is a smaller market, with $10.6M in obligations. Southwest Valley Constructors has 5 awards so far in FY2026 to date and an average award size of $451M.

faq.q: How much does Southwest Valley Constructors make from federal contracts?
faq.a: Southwest Valley Constructors has $2.3B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Southwest Valley Constructors received 5 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $451M. The current-year totals are partial and fiscal year to date.

faq.q: Which agencies buy from Southwest Valley Constructors?
faq.a: Department of Homeland Security buys the most from Southwest Valley Constructors, obligating $2.2B. Department of Defense also buys from Southwest Valley Constructors, obligating $10.6M.

faq.q: What does Southwest Valley Constructors sell to the government?
faq.a: Southwest Valley Constructors sells construction services to the government, primarily in Commercial and Institutional Building Construction with $2.2B in obligations. Southwest Valley Constructors also sells services in Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction with $10.6M in obligations.

faq.q: Which Southwest Valley Constructors contracts are expiring soon?
faq.a: No expiring-contracts figures are provided for Southwest Valley Constructors in the facts. The available figures cover obligations, award counts, average award size, buying agencies, and markets for FY2026 to date.
